entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex with VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm just so confused. I bought some cycling shoes from your website, and I don't think they're right for me. I need to send them back. The whole process is a bit overwhelming.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference or fit issue?

A fit issue, I think? I'm pretty new to all this. I went for one ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. And I don't really understand these plastic things... the cleats? on the bottom. It just feels wrong. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for you, and I'm sorry to hear that was your first ride with them. I'm looking at your account and see you received the shoes just five days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. Is that a problem? I couldn't figure out the policy on the website.
Not a problem at all. For items like our cycling shoes and apparel, we have a 90-day return policy, so you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's a relief! So I can get a refund? What do I need to do?

Yes, a full refund is no problem. I can email you a prepaid return shipping label right now. Additionally, I see you're a VIP member with us. To apologize for the trouble with the blisters and help you find a better fit, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Wow, a credit too? That is so nice of you! I was so worried I was going to be stuck with them. This is a huge help, thank you!

It's my pleasure. We want to make sure you're comfortable on your bike. The email with that label is on its way to you now. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off with the carrier. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much for making it so easy, Alex.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
